observed.caption: A large building covered in vibrant geometric murals stands behind a street with parked cars, motorcycles, pedestrians and flower vendors on the sidewalk.
observed.description: The image shows a large multi-story yellow building covered in colorful geometric murals and painted patterns occupying the center and right of the frame, with a lower wall featuring additional bright artwork and painted text. In the foreground a paved street holds a silver SUV and a white hatchback parked along the curb, a motorcycle with a rider wearing a red helmet and backpack traveling on the road, and several pedestrians walking on the street and sidewalk. On the right sidewalk buckets of flowers are displayed for sale near seated vendors and a parked motorcycle with a white box, while a red umbrella shades a market stall on the left near the building wall. In the background modern high-rise buildings with glass facades and a metal water tower with a billboard are visible under a bright sky, with green tree leaves hanging into the top edge of the frame.
